text:
MGN 357 (M+F) Amendment 1: night-time lookout – photochromic lenses and dark adaptation
Guidelines about avoiding the use of photochromic lenses and allowing time for dark adaptation when undertaking lookouts at night.
Documents
Details
This notice replaces MGN 357 (M+F).
Notice to all:
- ship operators
- masters
- skippers
- officers
- lookouts
